# IMQRPCResponse.timing property

When the service took the request off the queue, started the method and finished it, in milliseconds since the epoch by the service's clock.

**Signature:**

```typescript
timing?: IMQRPCTiming;
```

## Remarks

Absent on a response from a service older than this field. Only the differences between its own values mean anything to a caller, because the two clocks are not the same clock; [callTiming()](/api/rpc/latest/rpc.calltiming/) combines them with the caller's own round trip without comparing one with the other.
